exercises.title: Rescue without exposing
exercises.instruction: Move White's advanced man safely while leaving its blocker in place.

feedback.initial: Moving the blocker would expose its teammate. Advance the teammate instead.
feedback.selected: Move the advanced man off the attacker's diagonal.
feedback.success: White improved the position without exposing a teammate. The blocker stayed in place and the advanced man is safe.
feedback.goalMiss: Moving the blocker opens Black's capture. Leave it in place and move the advanced man instead.

exercises.title: Keep the lane closed
exercises.instruction: Move White's far edge piece while leaving both central pieces in place.

feedback.initial: Keep the target and its blocking teammate together.
feedback.selected: Choose a move that preserves the central arrangement.
feedback.success: The edge piece moved while Black's landing stayed occupied. The central teammate remains safe.
feedback.goalMiss: Leave both central pieces in place. Moving the blocker opens Black's landing; use the edge piece instead.

exercises.title: Do not walk into a jump
exercises.instruction: Move White's man to a destination Black cannot capture immediately.

feedback.initial: Picture Black's next move after each possible destination.
feedback.selected: Both steps are legal, but one walks into a capture.
feedback.success: White stayed away from Black's capture diagonal. Legal does not always mean safe.
feedback.goalMiss: On that square, Black can jump your man immediately. Try the other legal destination.

exercises.title: Keep the king's lane closed
exercises.instruction: Move Black's advanced man safely without vacating the white king's landing.

feedback.initial: The rear blocker denies the king a backward jump. Keep it there while moving the advanced man.
feedback.selected: Move the advanced black man away from the king's capture diagonal.
feedback.success: Black kept the landing closed and moved its teammate to safety. Both black pieces survived and the king has no immediate capture.
feedback.goalMiss: Vacating the rear blocker opens a backward capture. Keep it in place and move the advanced man.

exercises.title: Stay safe, then exploit
exercises.instruction: Choose White's safe step, then exploit the opportunity in Black's reply.

followUps.instruction: Black stepped into your capture diagonal. Take the exposed man.

feedback.initial: Your safe position now lets White punish Black's mistake.
feedback.success: White stayed safe and won a black man. You played the payoff instead of stopping at the setup.

feedback.initial: Compare the immediate reply after each destination.
feedback.selected: Choose the step Black cannot capture immediately.
feedback.awaitingReply: White is safe. Watch Black step into your capture diagonal.
feedback.success: White stayed safe and won a black man. You played the payoff instead of stopping at the setup.
feedback.goalMiss: Black can jump White on that square. Choose the other step.
